scope.hamiltonian: conventional-unscreened exact FP64 CUDA J/K in both modes
scope.preparation: fixture loading, RHS and independent oracle excluded; source/backend/resident creation included in setup
scope.warm: same owner, repeated RHS; each recycled solve starts with an empty space and recycles only within its four RHS
scope.cold_endpoint: plan setup + first solve/publication + final owner teardown; excludes process startup and oracle; the first provider setup may include lazy CUDA context initialization
scope.publication: one solution per RHS; final Arnoldi basis suppressed
scope.host_boundary: RHS validation/rank diagnostic, projected scalars/SVD/least squares and convergence remain host controlled
scope.component_timing: action-only operator; basis/projection/range orthogonalization; retained-space recycling; other costs only in full solve time
scope.memory: retained J/K + response arena and conservative logical solver reservation; excludes CUDA context/libraries and provider setup temporaries
scope.consumer: H2 native state, independent PySCF analytic Hessian and native dense parity reference prepared before complete HVP timing; first/second derivatives and final assembly use declared CPU defaults
scope.decision: qualification only; no production-size, changed-geometry performance, default selection or speedup promotion

jk_provider.memory_scope: retained direct J/K device allocations only; excludes preparation temporaries, host transforms/results, solver and CUDA context
